name: Sister Skelga

abilities.name: Ice Bolt
abilities.description: Basic ranged attack dealing high frost damage.

abilities.name: Flame Swirl
abilities.description: Sister Skelga summons a fire swirl that tracks your movement as it builds up, before erupting, dealing very high flame damage. After the eruption, a pool of flame will continue to follow your movement for a few more seconds, dealing continuous high flame damage that must be healed through.

abilities.name: Ice Burst
abilities.description: Sister Skelga raises her hands in the air, causing ice to burst from her, releasing four ice tornadoes going outward from her position, dealing very high ice damage and snaring you.

abilities.name: Dark Beam
abilities.description: Sister Skelga channels a beam of concentrated dark magic at you, dealing very high magical damage.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: Sister Skelga teleports to any of the arena's far end to put distance between you and her.

abilities.name: Summon Stranglers
abilities.description: Sister Skelga will periodically summon stranglers buffed with a large damage shield on the outskirts of the arena to pester you.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: I knew this ritual would bring trouble. Your new patron asks too much of us!
dialogue.trigger: After encountering Lyris Titanborn who is also fighting her way through the fortress, you exit the underkeep and enter an outdoor area with an altar. Skelga and Sister Hiti will be arguing before they notice you.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Hiti
dialogue.line: Enough of your mewling! These slow-witted Nords pose little threat.
dialogue.trigger: After encountering Lyris Titanborn who is also fighting her way through the fortress, you exit the underkeep and enter an outdoor area with an altar. Skelga and Sister Hiti will be arguing before they notice you.

dialogue.line: <They notice you.>
dialogue.trigger: After encountering Lyris Titanborn who is also fighting her way through the fortress, you exit the underkeep and enter an outdoor area with an altar. Skelga and Sister Hiti will be arguing before they notice you.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: Look here. More of them! Stay out of my way, Hiti.
dialogue.trigger: After encountering Lyris Titanborn who is also fighting her way through the fortress, you exit the underkeep and enter an outdoor area with an altar. Skelga and Sister Hiti will be arguing before they notice you.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Hiti
dialogue.line: I do as I please, sister!
dialogue.trigger: After encountering Lyris Titanborn who is also fighting her way through the fortress, you exit the underkeep and enter an outdoor area with an altar. Skelga and Sister Hiti will be arguing before they notice you.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: Look at them quiver! Cold, are you? Ha!

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: Leave the trespassers to me, sister.

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: I can smell your terror. Mmm … delicious!

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: If your flames scorch my children, Hiti, I'll gouge out your eyes!

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: I'll have your bones for a stew!

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: Get out of my garden! Get out!

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: I'll feed your frozen corpses to the sea!

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: You will never leave this island!

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: Wake, children! Wake!

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: Come out, pretties! Come out!
More feed for the garden ….
Finally, some peace and quiet.
Dead? Good. Now, where's my cauldron ….

dialogue.speaker: Sister Hiti
dialogue.line: Step aside, Skelga. I'll burn them alive!
dialogue.trigger: During the fight Hiti will use her fire magic, uncaring if it inadvertently gets in the way of Skelga's own attacks. When this happens, the pair will argue. Both characters have a pool of dialogue lines which are randomly chosen

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: Your flames are a blight shrew. Go join the rest of your coven.
dialogue.trigger: During the fight Hiti will use her fire magic, uncaring if it inadvertently gets in the way of Skelga's own attacks. When this happens, the pair will argue. Both characters have a pool of dialogue lines which are randomly chosen

dialogue.speaker: Sister Hiti
dialogue.line: Enough fooling about. Burn!
dialogue.trigger: During the fight Hiti will use her fire magic, uncaring if it inadvertently gets in the way of Skelga's own attacks. When this happens, the pair will argue. Both characters have a pool of dialogue lines which are randomly chosen

dialogue.speaker: Sister Skelga
dialogue.line: Leave this to me witch!
dialogue.trigger: During the fight Hiti will use her fire magic, uncaring if it inadvertently gets in the way of Skelga's own attacks. When this happens, the pair will argue. Both characters have a pool of dialogue lines which are randomly chosen

dialogue.speaker: Sister Hiti
dialogue.line: Skelga? Skelga! You … I'll burn you to cinders for this!
dialogue.trigger: Once you kill Skelga, Hiti will swear vengeance before teleporting away.

related_quests: The Frozen Isle: Brave the island of Icereach and look for survivors.
Pledge: Icereach: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Icereach.
summary: Sister Skelga is a hagraven associated with the Icereach Coven. She can be found outside after exiting the Icereach Underkeep and serves as the second boss for the dungeon.
